newsitem.title: USA: Daiwa Securities America expands forex desk.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Securities America expands forex desk.

text.p: Daiwa Securities Co Ltd's Daiwa Securities America Inc has beefed up its foreign exchange desk by recruiting five traders from Dean Witter Discover & Co's Dean Witter Reynolds Inc, said Barry Fetner, the new head of foreign exchange trading at Daiwa.
Daiwa is making "a commitment to expand the franchise in foreign exchange," Fetner said.
Besides Fetner, new members joining the Daiwa team from Dean Witter include Charles Farrell, the new chief dealer; and senior traders Marita Kroll, Catherine Stile and Eileen Tombasco, Fetner said.
The Daiwa forex desk now totals nine, Fetner said.
Fetner said, "The absolute commitment is to join everybody together into one ... group." He called the Daiwa Securities America team a "foreign exchange trading desk with a customer focus."

Dean Witter Discover and Morgan Stanley Group Inc announced in March a $10.3-billion merger that is expected to be completed in mid-1997. The new company will be named Morgan Stanley, Dean Witter, Discover & Co.
"And with the merger, it sort of created a great opportunity to bring all our resources over to Daiwa and create a ... desk that was not being merged," Fetner added.
